title: 第11章 流言如刀忍个屁第12章 测灵碑现空灵根
content_zh:
;;
突然！
人群之中一道灰衣身影全身颤抖，双拳紧握。
李盛安注意到了李观棋的异样连忙劝阻道：“兄弟！别冲动！忍一忍。”
李观棋猛地抬头望向那高台之上的少年，嘴唇被咬破流出些许鲜血。
砰！
少年脚下的石板顿时崩裂数块，口中怒吼道。
“忍个屁！！”
少年身形迅捷如风，一众少年竟只感觉到眼前一花。
就看到少年大步向前，龙行虎步般踩着一种再寻常不过的走桩脚法，对着那台上少年举拳砸去。
然而一旁的孟林海眼神微凝见状就要伸手阻拦。
身旁身穿紫色长袍的天雷峰二长老徐正杰给拦了下来。
“谁是谁非还不一定，怎能听一人之言？”
“况且…那小娃娃又不是接不下这一拳。”
赵元麟看到李观棋欺身而上霸道出拳，也是嘴角露出一抹冷笑。
一股十分细微的波动缓缓传出，竟是同样举拳和李观棋撞在了一起。
砰！
一道闷声响起。
赵元麟的身体竟是瞬间倒退了足足七步！
而浑身气血翻涌的瞎子则是站在原地一动未动。

“啊！！！臭瞎子！！你想死！！”
赵元麟此时右臂弯折成了一个诡异的弧度，众人无不暗暗心惊。
刚刚徐正杰还想出手阻拦赵元麟，因为这家伙已经初引天地灵气！
明显已经是锻体巅峰，甚至天人之感下已经接触到了灵气。
但令他没想到的是，那蒙住双眼的少年，在锻体实力上竟是直接碾压了对方！
根本不是一个量级的！
伴随着赵元麟的咒骂声，此时李观棋在所有拜宗弟子的眼中都成了一个恼怒出手的恶人。
谩骂声、诋毁声、充斥着整个广场。
“哼！这人就是心虚了才出手的！”
“没错，能用亲人的性命还钱之人，我看也不是什么好鸟。”
“对！大夏剑宗那位师兄不是说收弟子首先看品行吗？我看这人就品行低劣之极！”
“如果这样的人也能进入宗门，我等羞与为伍！”
“……”
徐正杰眉头一皱，声音夹杂着灵力震慑众人。
“够了！安静！”
伴随着灵音落下，广场上变得鸦雀无声。
就在这时，人群中的林东双拳紧握，浑身颤抖。
他一路上跟随李观棋攀登天梯，后又聊得颇为亲近。
在他看来，少年根本不会做出赵元麟口中所说的那种事！
小胖子李盛安连忙拉住他，低头急促的说道：“你要干什么！你也疯了么！”

“就算是观棋没有做过那些事，赵元麟身为天灵根，必然会受到偏爱成为那内门弟子，甚至是长老门下的核心弟子。”
“你出头，不怕以后被报复么！”
可林东却深深的看了一眼李盛安，轻声说道：“若人人都不做声，看见不公都选择闭上眼睛，那还修仙作甚！”
一道洪亮的声音陡然在人群中响起！
“我不相信他会这么做！”

Sudden!
A figure in gray clothes among the crowd was trembling all over, clenching his fists.
Li Sheng'an noticed Li Guanqi's strange behavior and quickly dissuaded him: "Brother! Don't be impulsive! Be patient."
Li Guanqi suddenly looked up at the young man on the high platform, his lip was bitten and some blood flowed out.
Bang!
The stone slab under the young man's feet suddenly cracked into several pieces, and he roared angrily.
"Hold on!"
The young man's figure was as fast as the wind, and all the young men could only feel a blur in front of their eyes.
I saw the young man striding forward, using a very common walking technique like a dragon and a tiger, and raised his fist to hit the young man on the stage.
However, Meng Linhai's eyes narrowed slightly and he reached out to stop him.
Next to him, Xu Zhengjie, the second elder of Tianlei Peak who was wearing a purple robe, stopped him.
"It's not clear who is right or wrong, how can you listen to one person's words?"
"Besides...it's not like that little baby can't take this punch."
Zhao Yuanlin also had a sneer on his lips when he saw Li Guanqi bullying him and punching him arrogantly.
A very subtle wave slowly spread out, and the same fist raised and collided with Li Guanqi.
Bang!
A muffled sound sounded.
Zhao Yuanlin's body actually took a full seven steps back in an instant!
The blind man, whose body was full of energy and blood, stood motionless.
"Ah!!! Blind man!! You want to die!!"
At this time, Zhao Yuanlin's right arm was bent into a strange arc, and everyone was secretly shocked.
Just now Xu Zhengjie wanted to stop Zhao Yuanlin because this guy had already attracted the spiritual energy of heaven and earth for the first time!
It is obvious that he has reached the peak of physical training, and has even been exposed to spiritual energy under the sense of heaven and man.
But what he didn't expect was that the blindfolded boy could directly crush the opponent in terms of physical training strength!
It’s not of the same magnitude at all!
Accompanied by Zhao Yuanlin's curse, Li Guanqi now became a villain who took action in anger in the eyes of all the disciples who worshiped the sect.
Abuse and slander filled the square.
"Hmph! This person took action because he felt guilty!"
"That's right, I don't think anyone who can pay back money with the life of a loved one is a good person."
"Yes! Didn't the senior brother of Daxia Sword Sect say that when accepting a disciple, one should first look at his character? I think this person has extremely low character!"
"If such a person can enter the sect, we will be ashamed to be associated with him!"
"..."
Xu Zhengjie frowned, and his voice mixed with spiritual power shocked everyone.
"That's enough! Quiet!"
As the spiritual sound fell, the square became silent.
At this moment, Lin Dong in the crowd clenched his fists and trembled all over.
He followed Li Guanqi along the way to climb the ladder, and later chatted quite closely with him.
In his opinion, the young man would never do what Zhao Yuanlin said!
The little fat man Li Sheng'an quickly grabbed him, lowered his head and said hastily: "What are you going to do! Are you crazy too!"
"Even if Guan Qi has not done those things, Zhao Yuanlin, as Tianlinggen, will definitely be favored to become the inner disciple, or even the core disciple of the elder's disciple."
"Aren't you afraid of being retaliated against in the future if you stand up for me?"
But Lin Dong took a deep look at Li Sheng'an and said softly: "If everyone keeps silent and chooses to close their eyes when they see injustice, then why are they cultivating immortals?"
A loud voice suddenly sounded in the crowd!
"I don't believe he would do this!"
